hero.caption: ABOUT US
hero.title: Redefining Diagnostics
hero.description: PolarisDX stands for innovation, precision, and reliability in medical technology. Meet the people behind our mission.

tim_ritson.name: Tim Ritson
tim_ritson.bio: As CEO of Polaris Diagnostics Limited in London, Tim Ritson leads the strategic vision of the company. With decades of operational experience, he steers the global direction and growth of PolarisDX.

adriano_zucalla.name: Adriano Zuccala
adriano_zucalla.bio: Adriano Zuccala is responsible for the European business as CEO of Polaris Diagnostics Europe GmbH. His focus is on sales and strategic market development to make innovative diagnostic solutions accessible.

frank_stoffels.name: Frank Stoffels
frank_stoffels.bio: As Sales Director, Frank Stoffels brings extensive expertise from the MedTech industry. He is the face of PolarisDX at international trade fairs and the first point of contact for our customers on sales issues.

ulrike_schuerholz.name: Ulrike Schuerholz
ulrike_schuerholz.bio: As Senior Global Operations Director, Ulrike Schuerholz manages operational processes. She ensures efficient processes and the strategic implementation of our corporate goals in a global context.

mission.caption: Our Mission
mission.title: Bringing lab-grade diagnostics to where patients are treated
mission.lead: PolarisDX makes lab-grade point-of-care diagnostics accessible to practices and clinics across Europe — vendor-agnostic, IVDR/CE compliant, and ready to use within a few business days.
mission.body: From our offices in London and Hamburg, we support physicians from selection through integration to ongoing support — so diagnostics at the patient become faster, more precise, and more economical.
mission.point1: Vendor-agnostic POC diagnostics from a single source
mission.point3: Ongoing support in more than 15 countries
mission.highlight_text: The IglooPro POC reader delivers lab-comparable values right at the point of care. Less waiting, fewer trips, faster treatment decisions.

precision.title: Precision
precision.text: Lab-comparable results with a coefficient of variation below 2% — diagnostics you can rely on.

proximity.title: Patient proximity
proximity.text: Diagnostics right at the point of care shortens trips and waiting times and strengthens the bond with your patients.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.text: IVDR/CE compliant technology, personal support, and delivery within 3–5 business days — from London and Hamburg.

dx365_partner.caption: Our Partner
dx365_partner.title: European distribution partner of DX365
dx365_partner.body: As the European distribution partner of <dx365>DX365</dx365>, we bring the IglooPro POC reader to practices and clinics — including sales, integration, training, and ongoing support.

seo.title: About PolarisDX: Your Partner in POC Diagnostics
seo.description: Innovation, precision and reliability in medical technology: meet the PolarisDX team and our mission to redefine point-of-care diagnostics in Europe.
